name: @ttsc/station
description: Standalone TypeScript-Go compiler, runtime, plugin host, and LSP host workspace.

scripts.test: pnpm run test:go && pnpm run test:units
scripts.format: pnpm run gen:flags --skip-website && prettier --write --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern "**/*.ts" "**/*.md" "**/*.mdx" "!website/**" && pnpm run format:go
scripts.package:next:publish: pnpm --filter=./packages/* --filter=!ttsc --filter=!@ttsc/graph --filter=!@ttsc/unplugin --filter=!@ttsc/metro -r publish --tag next --access public --no-git-checks --provenance && pnpm --filter ttsc publish --tag next --access public --no-git-checks --provenance && pnpm --filter @ttsc/graph publish --tag next --access public --no-git-checks --provenance && pnpm --filter @ttsc/unplugin publish --tag next --access public --no-git-checks --provenance && pnpm --filter @ttsc/metro publish --tag next --access public --no-git-checks --provenance
scripts.package:latest:publish: pnpm --filter=./packages/* --filter=!ttsc --filter=!@ttsc/graph -r publish --tag latest --access public --no-git-checks --provenance && pnpm --filter @ttsc/graph publish --tag latest --access public --no-git-checks --provenance && pnpm --filter ttsc publish --tag latest --access public --no-git-checks --provenance

author: Jeongho Nam
